articles.title: Welcome!

articles.title: Packages, variables, and functions.
articles.subtitle: Learn the basic components of any Go program.

articles.title: More types: structs, slices, and maps.

articles.subtitle: Go provides concurrency constructs as part of the core language. This lesson introduces them and shows how they can be used.
